design_detail: 2.5% on the very rich with a high threshold
quote_original: Antaranya ialah menilai kepada pembangunan cukai kekayaan agar kita tidak terlalu bergantung kepada pencukaian berasaskan pendapatan dan perbelanjaan rakyat. Cukai kekayaan ini boleh dikenakan kepada golongan yang sangat kaya dengan meletakkan satu nilai ambang yang tinggi dengan peratusan mengikut peratus zakat iaitu 2.5 peratus.
quote_en: Among them is evaluating the development of a wealth tax so that we do not rely too heavily on taxation based on people's income and expenditure. This wealth tax can be imposed on the very rich by setting a high threshold with a percentage following the zakat rate of 2.5 percent.
source_title: Penyata Rasmi Parlimen Dewan Rakyat DR 16.10.2025
grading_note: Formal parliamentary debate on Supply Bill 2026 proposing an explicit 2.5% wealth tax above a high threshold.

design_detail: wealth tax on multimillionaires and billionaires above US$1m
quote_original: maka adalah sepatutunya sampai pad awaktunya kerajaan mengenakan cukai kekayaan kepada orang-orang kaya ini, iaitu multimillionaire, maha jutawan, billionaire supaya jangan ada kekayaan ini berlegar di sekelliling beberapa kerat saja
quote_en: so it is duly time for the government to impose a wealth tax on these rich people, namely multimillionaires, tycoons, billionaires so that this wealth does not remain circulating among just a handful of people
source_title: Hassan Karim gesa kerajaan segera cukai ‘maha jutawan’
grading_note: Speech in Dewan Rakyat debate on Supply Bill 2026 proposing a wealth tax on multimillionaires and billionaires.

design_detail: wealth tax on multimillionaires and billionaires
quote_original: So in the same vein, I argue that it is time for the government to impose a wealth tax on the rich – the multimillionaires, the billionaires – so that wealth does not remain concentrated among just a handful of people.
source_title: Time for ultra-rich to pay wealth tax, says Hassan
grading_note: Public interview statement urging a wealth tax on the ultra-rich.

design_detail: 2.5% tax on stock wealth and corporate reserves
quote_original: Cukai kekayaan yang hari ini kalau kita lihat di England sebagai contoh, sedang bincang cukai kekayaan dua persen dan kita lihat dalam Islam mencadangkan untuk kita mengambil cukai terhadap kekayaan mereka yang melabur dalam saham dan cukai terhadap simpanan korporat.
quote_en: The wealth tax that today if we look at England as an example is discussing a two percent wealth tax, and we see in Islam proposing that we tax the wealth of those who invest in stocks and tax corporate reserves.
source_title: Penyata Rasmi Parlimen Dewan Rakyat DR 16.10.2019
grading_note: Speech in Dewan Rakyat proposing a 2.5% tax on stock holdings and corporate reserves.

quote_original: I am more attracted to the idea of a wealth tax... It would be like getting rid of a Lamborghini or something like that. It would not make much difference to them.
source_title: 'Like giving up a Lamborghini': Santiago says wealth tax on super-rich could raise RM10 bil
grading_note: Podcast statement proposing a 2% to 2.5% wealth tax on Malaysia's 50 richest people.

design_detail: 2% on net assets between RM1bn and RM2bn up to 10% on >RM30bn
quote_original: PSM mencadangkan satu cukai baru ke atas kekayaan individu dengan aset yang melebihi RM1 bilion... Golongan terkaya ini harus dicukai dengan kadar 2% untuk mereka yang memiliki aset bernilai antara RM1 bilion hingga ke RM2 bilion. Kadar cukai kekayaan harus ditingkatkan secara berperingkat ke 10% untuk mereka yang memiliki RM30 bilion ke atas.
quote_en: PSM proposes a new tax on individual wealth with assets exceeding RM1 billion... The richest group should be taxed at a rate of 2% for those with assets valued between RM1 billion and RM2 billion. The wealth tax rate should be graduated up to 10% for those with RM30 billion and above.
source_title: Kemelesetan ekonomi pasca COVID-19: Cadangan PSM untuk pulihkan negara demi rakyat
grading_note: Authored PSM policy document setting out a graduated wealth tax on billionaires from 2% to 10%.

design_detail: wealth tax on individuals with assets exceeding RM500m
quote_original: Imposing a wealth tax on individuals who have assets exceeding RM500m
source_title: How the government can increase its revenue over the long term
grading_note: Policy memorandum proposing a wealth tax on net assets exceeding RM500 million.

design_detail: wealth tax on Malaysia's 50 richest individuals
quote_original: Timbalan pengerusi PSM S Arutchelvan hari ini menggesa agar cukai kekayaan diperkenalkan berikutan laporan bahawa lima puluh orang terkaya di Malaysia meningkatkan kekayaan mereka.
quote_en: PSM deputy chairman S Arutchelvan today urged that a wealth tax be introduced following reports that the fifty richest people in Malaysia increased their wealth.
grading_note: Public statement urging a wealth tax on the 50 richest tycoons.

design_detail: party congress resolution calling for wealth tax
quote_original: Kerajaan harus melaksanakan sistem percukaian yang lebih progresif bagi mengurangkan ketidaksamaan dalam pengagihan kekayaan, dengan memperkenalkan cukai pusaka, cukai kekayaan dan cukai ke atas rumah kedua atau rumah yang dibiarkan kosong.
quote_en: The government should implement a more progressive tax system to reduce inequality in wealth distribution, by introducing inheritance tax, wealth tax and a tax on second homes or vacant houses.
grading_note: Formal resolution adopted at the 28th National Congress of Parti Sosialis Malaysia.

design_detail: 2% wealth tax on top 50 richest individuals in Malaysia
quote_original: Cukai kekayaan sebanyak dua peratus akan membolehkan kerajaan mengutip RM8.3 bilion – iaitu 60 peratus lebih banyak daripada RM5 bilion yang disasarkan melalui kenaikan SST.
quote_en: A two percent wealth tax would enable the government to collect RM8.3 billion – 60 percent more than the RM5 billion targeted through the SST hike.
source_title: SST: Kenapa cukai pisang bukan maha kaya, soal NGO
grading_note: Campaign proposal advocating a 2% wealth tax on Malaysia's top 50 billionaires.

quote_original: Menurut laporan Unicef, keluarga berpendapatan rendah membelanjakan 38 peratus daripada pendapatan mereka untuk membeli makanan... Namun kita masih terus mengenakan cukai ke atas penggunaan, bukannya kekayaan
quote_en: According to the Unicef report, low-income families spend 38 percent of their income on food. Yet we still continue to impose taxes on consumption, rather than wealth
source_title: SST: Kenapa cukai pisang bukan maha kaya, soal NGO
grading_note: Public statement calling for a 2% wealth tax on top billionaires instead of taxing consumption.

quote_original: Option 1: A 2% tax on the top 100 richest people in Malaysia... Option 2: A broader, graduated wealth tax – 1% on wealth above RM100m and 1.5% on wealth above RM500m.
source_title: Could a wealth tax fix Malaysia’s inequality crisis?
grading_note: Authored op-ed detailing specific rate and threshold designs for wealth taxation in Malaysia.

design_detail: 2% wealth tax on top wealth concentration
quote_original: The Ministry of Finance recently said in a statement that Malaysia has "no plans" to introduce a 2% wealth tax, because the country's tax base is "small and limited". But this raises a fundamental question. If the tax base is indeed narrow, why does the government continue to refuse to tax the greatest concentration of wealth in the country?
grading_note: Op-ed critiquing the government for rejecting a 2% wealth tax.

design_detail: tax on wealth and excess profits
quote_original: He said governments should target tax on excess profits and wealth, raising the concern that rich corporations and individuals paid less and less in direct taxes, while the public paid more and more in indirect taxation, typically on consumption.
source_title: Commentary: GE15 - Fixing Malaysia’s healthcare system will require money, not just election pledges
grading_note: Argued that governments should target direct tax on excess profits and wealth rather than regressive consumption.

design_detail: high-exemption wealth tax targeting concentrated capital
quote_original: Merely increasing income tax or making income tax more progressive but without re-distributive means would not cure the issue of wealth disparity. The argument of wealth tax stifling economic growth and innovation is typically false as most innovation is produced by young, not wealthy individuals who would not be impacted by a high-exemption wealth tax
source_title: Tax! Tax! Tax! For the Common Good
grading_note: Policy analysis by think tank defending a high-exemption wealth tax.

quote_original: Merely increasing income tax or making income tax more progressive but without re-distributive means would not cure the issue of wealth disparity. The argument of wealth tax stifling economic growth and innovation is typically false as most innovation is produced by young, not wealthy individuals who would not be impacted by a high-exemption wealth tax, where the wealthy often "own" and put in patents rather than innovate.
source_title: Tax! Tax! Tax! For the Common Good
grading_note: Interview on tax policy defending wealth taxation as essential to address wealth concentration.

design_detail: wealth tax on the wealthy class
quote_original: As usual, truly impactful measures like increasing corporate taxes and imposing wealth and inheritance taxes were glaringly absent from the budget... As things stand, the government's fiscal position remains strained precisely because it is stubbornly reluctant to impose such progressive taxes.
source_title: Budget 2027: Deliberately avoiding the big picture
grading_note: Commentary advocating the introduction of wealth taxation in the national budget.

design_detail: wealth tax on top 50 richest individuals
quote_original: Given the sheer amount of wealth these individuals possess and the current dire socioeconomic conditions many face, surely it would not be unreasonable for the government to impose a wealth tax on this particular group so that more funds are available to help support the majority?
source_title: LETTER | We need progressive taxation now
grading_note: Letter in Malaysiakini arguing for a wealth tax on the top 50 richest listees.

design_detail: wealth tax to fund public healthcare
quote_original: A form of wealth tax could be a source of funding that support and enhance public healthcare and other services. But finding the right balance of how to do so will always be tricky
source_title: Commentary: GE15 - Fixing Malaysia’s healthcare system will require money, not just election pledges
grading_note: Policy commentary advocating for a wealth tax to fund public health services.
